data.title: Marina Cove
data.about:
Marina Cove at Dubai Marina is a distinguished residential development by Emaar Properties, enhancing the iconic skyline with its striking presence. It offers luxurious waterfront living, complemented by breathtaking marina views, world-class amenities, and seamless access to the city’s vibrant lifestyle.

This 32-story high-rise showcases a premium selection of apartments, ranging from 1 to 4-bedroom units. The development is equipped with facilities, including a swimming pool, fitness center, children's play area, landscaped terrace, and more.

With direct access to the Dubai Marina Mall, Pier 7, and the vibrant Marina Promenade, Marina Cove offers the best of Dubai's retail, dining, and leisure experiences just steps away.

characteristics_module.title: Emaar’s Final Masterpiece in Dubai Marina
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• As Emaar’s final launch in one of the most sought-after locations, Marina Cove is a destination meticulously curated for the elite few, offering an exclusive lifestyle.
  • Nestled in the heart of Dubai Marina, providing picturesque marina views and direct access to waterfront promenades.
  • A selection of premium apartments featuring modern layouts, high-end finishes, and spacious interiors designed for ultimate comfort and sophistication.
  • Apartments offer panoramic vistas of the marina, Arabian Gulf, and Dubai’s iconic skyline.
  • Conveniently connected to Dubai’s metro and tram networks, ensuring easy access to major attractions, business hubs, and airports.
  • Developed by Emaar Properties, renowned for its world-class projects, high-quality craftsmanship, and exceptional investment potential.
  • Surrounded by lively restaurants, cafes, retail outlets, and entertainment venues, embodying the dynamic spirit of Dubai Marina.
    Investment Opportunity
  • High demand for properties in Dubai Marina offers strong rental yields and excellent capital appreciation potential, making it ideal for investors.

location_tile.title: Live in Dubai's Most Sought-after Location!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Marina Cove enjoys a prime location in the heart of Dubai Marina, one of the most prestigious and sought-after waterfront destinations in the city.

The area is renowned for its dynamic lifestyle, with yacht clubs, beaches, and entertainment venues just moments away. Marina Cove provides convenient access to key business districts, shopping malls, and airports, making it an ideal choice for both residents and investors seeking luxury with urban convenience.

  • Dubai Marina Mall – Just steps away
  • Pier 7 – A short walk from the residence
  • Address Dubai Marina – Within walking distance
  • Tram Station – Easily accessible on foot
  • Palm Jumeirah – 10-minute drive
  • Mall of the Emirates – 15-minute drive
  • Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) – 5-minute drive
